jobs.description:
Allied Universal is looking for Event Staff in Houston, Texas, to manage ticketing and ensure guest experiences at events. The job offers weekly pay at $17/hr, paid training, and a supportive work environment with numerous benefits including a 401(k) and employee discounts. Join us for an exciting career at Allied Universal!
